SELECT s.id AS scope_id, s.order_line_id, s.product_code, s.product_desc, product.product_model, product.product_name, s.order_no, s.allocated_qty AS allocated_quantity, l.id AS matched_line_id, l.product_code AS line_product_code, l.delivered_qty AS delivered_quantity, l.open_qty AS open_quantity FROM com_delivery_scope s
LEFT JOIN ast_product_official_info product ON product.tenant_id=s.tenant_id AND product.product_code=s.product_code AND product.deleted=0 LEFT JOIN com_sales_order_line l ON l.tenant_id=s.tenant_id AND l.id=s.order_line_id AND l.deleted=0 AND (
CAST(l.company_code AS BINARY) IN CAST(#{code} AS BINARY) OR
EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM com_order_contract_relation ocr JOIN com_project_contract_relation pcr ON pcr.tenant_id=ocr.tenant_id AND pcr.contract_id=ocr.contract_id AND pcr.deleted=0 AND pcr.status='ACTIVE' AND pcr.effective_to IS NULL WHERE ocr.tenant_id=l.tenant_id AND ocr.order_id=l.order_id AND ocr.deleted=0 AND pcr.project_id IN #{id}) OR
1=0 ) WHERE s.tenant_id=#{query.tenantId} AND s.project_id=#{query.projectId} AND s.scope_status='ACTIVE' AND s.effective_to IS NULL AND s.deleted=0 AND s.id>#{query.afterId} ORDER BY s.id LIMIT #{query.limit}
